def piece_positions(frame):
    c = frame.ascii.split('\n')
    def runs(row, ch):
        out=[]; s=None
        for i,ch2 in enumerate(row):
            if ch2==ch:
                if s is None: s=i
            else:
                if s is not None: out.append((s,i-1)); s=None
        if s is not None: out.append((s,len(row)-1))
        return out
    res={}
    for ch,name in [('R','red'),('r','dred'),('b','blue'),('g','gray'),('N','green'),('Y','yellow')]:
        cells=[]
        for r in range(10,55):
            for (s,e) in runs(c[r],ch):
                cells.append((r,s,e))
        if cells:
            rs=[x[0] for x in cells]; 
            res[name]=(min(rs),max(rs))
    # checkerboard: b/c alternating in a 4x4
    return res
